items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: That Matthews and I'm pretty sure Greenwood and I and perhaps somebody else did go to Campbell's and took some photographs

ctx.x: Let's see. His notes if I'm reading them right I'll have to go back and check the journal on this. Greenwood? Yeah. He talks about Chapatulis and Napoleon. Herb Moran was at Campbell's. He's not there anymore and the date I believe is the 10th of December 1949. That's his entry. Yeah that's his entry. He's not there anymore. And uh I read this to you yesterday or a few days ago. Yeah. Anyway about him going to Napoleon and Ferret at 3 a.m. With Herb, Albert Burbank, Albert Giles, Prince Gabriel and three white…

I know. It could have been Bob Matthews, you and somebody else. Could well have been. Eight people in the car. Could well have been. We didn't, none of us had wheels at that time. I didn't even know how to drive at that time. Uh I certainly it was in the latter part of November. Uh huh. That Matthews and I'm pretty sure Greenwood and I and perhaps somebody else did go to Campbell's and took some photographs. Could have been on the same night you went to Bergen. I don't know why but I have the impression it was…
You said something about. Not uh. Knowing Almond Hug. I mean not hearing Almond Hug. Yes I don't remember ever having gone to hear Almond.

items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: Why, why Bob Matthews? Why do you include Bob Matthews?

ctx.x: Well, uh, if it's the one I'm thinking about, uh, you know, of course I can't place it, both Talbot and Moran were there, full George Lewis band, Talbot Moran, Burbank, and Bob Matthews.
Why, why Bob Matthews? Why do you include Bob Matthews?
Because he's on the tapes. Oh, is he? Oh. Yeah.
